The supplementary analysis 7 examines the incidence of severe bleeding among prevalent patients with atrial fibrillation, categorized by their type of anticoagulant treatment [^src1]. The data reveals significant variations in bleeding risks depending on the specific medication regimen prescribed.

Patients receiving a combination of both [[doac|DOAC]] and [[marevan]] exhibit the highest rate of severe bleeding, acting as the clear outlier in this comparison with a bleeding proportion of 6.45% (69 cases) [^src1]. In contrast, the lowest incidence of severe bleeding is observed in patients receiving neither DOAC nor Marevan, who show a bleeding proportion of just 1.31% (357 cases) [^src1]. 

For patients on standard anticoagulant therapy (AK-behandling), the severe bleeding rate is 2.30% [^src1]. Those specifically on Marevan have a slightly higher rate at 2.38% [^src1]. Notably, the data for patients exclusively on DOAC is entirely missing or unreported in this specific table section, represented by dashes [^src1]. Because this analysis is drawn from a single dated section, no longitudinal trends regarding bleeding rates over time can be established.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Alle | 134161 | 97.86 | 2929 | 2.14 |
| AK-behandling | 99866 | 97.70 | 2349 | 2.30 |
| DOAC | — | — | — | — |
| Marevan | 6321 | 97.62 | 154 | 2.38 |
| Både DOAC og Marevan | 1000 | 93.55 | 69 | 6.45 |
| Hverken DOAC eller Marevan | 26974 | 98.69 | 357 | 1.31 |

Entities: supplerende-analyser-7, doac, marevan

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner forekomsten af alvorlig blødning blandt prævalente patienter med atrieflimren efter type af antikoagulationsbehandling, og viser at kombineret DOAC og Marevan-behandling har den højeste andel af alvorlig blødning (6,45 %).
